concepts.title: RV Maintenance Evidence Book
concepts.subtitle: A New Owner's System for Extracting Schedules, Tracking Service, Protecting Warranty Records, Checking Recalls, and Preserving Resale History
concepts.buyer: New or recently upgraded RV owner
concepts.trigger: Taking ownership, approaching a service interval, warranty issue, recall check or resale preparation
concepts.task: Build one source-linked maintenance evidence trail without relying on memory
concepts.product: Paperback-first guided system: manual-source index, schedule extraction sheets, service and repair records, warranty/recall workflow, receipt index and question generator
concepts.why_book: The physical record stays with the vehicle documents and remains usable during service visits and resale handoff.
concepts.why_not_free: Unlike a blank spreadsheet, free template or app, it teaches the owner how to extract manufacturer-specific obligations and preserve the evidence needed to act on them.
concepts.production_shape: 8x10 or 8.5x11 black-and-white, approximately 100-140 pages; source-dependent and no repair advice
concepts.main_uncertainty: Whether enough buyers will pay a guided-system premium over $6.99 blank logs and free apps
concepts.next_gate: Create only a 6-8 page extraction/evidence-flow prototype and blind-score paid value against a blank log and app.

concepts.title: Self-Fitting Triage Workbook for Sewists
concepts.trigger: A muslin fits poorly and comprehensive fitting books feel too difficult to apply without a helper
concepts.task: Diagnose one observable fit problem, test one change and document the next iteration
concepts.product: A photo-led color self-fitting decision workbook organized by observable symptoms and balance lines
concepts.why_book: A physical spread can pair full-body observations, alteration sequence and muslin notes at the worktable.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Whether original visual instruction and expert review can be sourced cheaply enough to make the result authoritative and economical
concepts.next_gate: Test original-image rights, expert-review availability and color printing economics before any prototype.
